_comment: Authored layouts for the bundled Core Vocabulary set (§19).
One entry per GRID SIZE, because a motor-plan layout cannot be reflowed
(§19.2): changing the grid moves every word, so each size is authored
separately and chosen once at setup rather than resized later.
Each word is [label, partOfSpeech, level]. Level is the vocabulary level
at which the word is INTRODUCED — 1 Basic, 2 Intermediate, 3 Advanced.
Levels reveal words in place: a word's row and column come from its
position in these arrays, so raising a user's level only un-hides cells
and never moves anything already on the board. That is what makes a
grow-with-me path compatible with §19.1's 'core words never move'.
Core is level 1 at every size. Core words are the highest-value words on
the board and the whole reason the persistent region exists; levels tier
the fringe around them.
Word selection is the §19.4 candidate set. TODO(§19.6): SLP review before
v1.0 — see scripts/symbols/ for the symbol mapping these labels drive.
corePages marks the pages holding CORE vocabulary (words that work in any
context) and gives each the Fitzgerald colour of its contents, so the home
page shows at a glance that green leads to verbs and purple to describing
words. Pages not listed are topic/fringe pages and stay category grey.
Core pages are ordered first and are always level 1.
